text: A Song of the Ascents. 1 In YHWH turning back the captivity of Zion, we were like those dreaming.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, “YHWH, has done great things for these.”
YHWH has done great things for us; and we came to be glad.
Bring back, O YHWH, our captives, like streams in the Negev!
Those sowing in tears will reap with a shout of joy.
Going forth, he who goes and weeps, bearing the basket of seed, coming in, he comes with a shout, bearing his sheaves.
